ideas.title: AI Career Gap Analyser
ideas.problem: Students do not know which skills separate them from a target role.
ideas.whyItMatters: Unfocused learning wastes months and weakens placements.
ideas.solution: Compare a student’s skills with a role’s skill list and output a ranked learning path.
ideas.mvpScope: Role skill taxonomy, skills input, gap score, ordered learning plan.
ideas.advancedFeatures: LLM-assisted resume parsing, progress tracking over time.
ideas.differentiator: Transparent scoring: every gap shows why it was flagged, rather than a black-box score.
ideas.challenges: Role taxonomies go stale; needs manual curation.
ideas.datasetsNote: Check job-skill datasets (e.g. O*NET, ESCO) for licence and fit before use.
ideas.demoSuggestion: Live demo: paste skills, show gap and 4-week plan.

ideas.title: Campus Assistant on Verified Documents
ideas.problem: Students struggle to find rules, deadlines and procedures buried in PDFs.
ideas.whyItMatters: Wrong answers about exams or fees cause real harm, so answers must be traceable.
ideas.solution: RAG chatbot that answers only from uploaded institutional documents and cites the source passage.
ideas.mvpScope: Upload PDFs, chunk and embed, answer with citations, refuse when unsupported.
ideas.advancedFeatures: Role-based documents, multilingual answers, feedback loop.
ideas.differentiator: Refuses when evidence is missing and always shows the quote it relied on.
ideas.challenges: Document quality, chunking errors, hallucination risk.
ideas.datasetsNote: Use the institution’s own documents (needs permission).
ideas.demoSuggestion: Ask three questions, one deliberately unanswerable.

ideas.title: Phishing Awareness and URL Risk Trainer
ideas.problem: People fall for phishing because training is generic and passive.
ideas.whyItMatters: Phishing is a leading entry point for breaches.
ideas.solution: Interactive quiz of realistic (fake) emails and a URL checker that explains red flags using transparent rules.
ideas.mvpScope: 20 sample emails, rule-based URL checker, score and explanations.
ideas.advancedFeatures: Admin dashboard for organisations, regional-language scenarios.
ideas.differentiator: Explains each red flag instead of just saying safe or unsafe.
ideas.challenges: Rule-based checks miss novel attacks; say so clearly.
ideas.datasetsNote: Public phishing feeds exist (e.g. PhishTank); check terms and availability.
ideas.demoSuggestion: Let judges try to fool the trainer.

ideas.title: Spaced-Repetition Study Assistant
ideas.problem: Students cram and forget within weeks.
ideas.whyItMatters: Spaced review is well documented to improve retention.
ideas.solution: Flashcards scheduled by a simple SM-2 style algorithm, with import from notes.
ideas.mvpScope: Create decks, review queue, scheduling algorithm, streak view.
ideas.advancedFeatures: Auto-generate cards from notes, shared decks.
ideas.differentiator: Ties card decks to roadmap topics so review follows what you are learning.
ideas.challenges: Card quality depends on the student.
ideas.demoSuggestion: Show retention curve across two simulated weeks.

ideas.title: Crop Disease Identification and Advisory
ideas.problem: Farmers detect plant disease late and lack nearby expert advice.
ideas.whyItMatters: Early detection reduces crop loss and unnecessary pesticide use.
ideas.solution: Photo-based disease classifier with treatment guidance reviewed against agricultural sources.
ideas.mvpScope: Image upload, classifier on a few crops, confidence score, advisory text with source.
ideas.advancedFeatures: Offline mobile mode, regional languages, expert review queue.
ideas.suggestedStack: React Native or PWA, FastAPI, PyTorch/TensorFlow
ideas.differentiator: Shows low-confidence cases honestly and routes them to a human expert.
ideas.challenges: Field images differ from lab images; accuracy claims need care.
ideas.datasetsNote: Check PlantVillage dataset licence and limitations before use.
ideas.demoSuggestion: Demo on real leaf photos, not only dataset images.

ideas.title: Smart Water Leakage Monitoring
ideas.problem: Municipal pipes leak unseen, wasting treated water.
ideas.whyItMatters: Water loss is costly and scarce in many cities.
ideas.solution: Flow sensors on a pipe loop publish data; the dashboard flags anomalies between upstream and downstream readings.
ideas.mvpScope: Two flow sensors, MQTT, dashboard with threshold-based alerts.
ideas.advancedFeatures: ML anomaly detection, GIS map of nodes.
ideas.suggestedStack: ESP32, MQTT, Node.js, InfluxDB or PostgreSQL
ideas.differentiator: Physical demo with a controlled leak makes the impact visible.
ideas.challenges: Sensor calibration and noise; prototype is a model, not a city deployment.
ideas.demoSuggestion: Open a valve live and show the alert fire.

ideas.title: Voice-Based Navigation Assistant
ideas.problem: Visually impaired users find many web pages hard to navigate.
ideas.whyItMatters: Accessibility is a basic right and often an afterthought.
ideas.solution: Browser extension that reads page structure aloud and accepts voice commands to jump between sections.
ideas.mvpScope: Landmark detection, speak headings, voice commands for next, back, read.
ideas.advancedFeatures: Image alt-text suggestions, custom command sets.
ideas.suggestedStack: JavaScript, Web Speech API (check browser support), Chrome extension
ideas.differentiator: Built with and tested by assistive-tech users where possible.
ideas.challenges: Speech APIs vary by browser and language.
ideas.demoSuggestion: Demo with eyes closed, navigating a real site.

ideas.title: GitHub Repository Health Dashboard
ideas.problem: Contributors cannot easily judge whether a project is active and welcoming.
ideas.whyItMatters: Choosing healthy projects improves first-contribution success.
ideas.solution: Dashboard that scores a repository on activity, issue response time and contributor-friendliness using public data.
ideas.mvpScope: Enter a repo, fetch stats, show a score breakdown.
ideas.advancedFeatures: Compare repos, trend charts, good-first-issue finder.
ideas.suggestedStack: React, GitHub REST API (check rate limits), Chart library
ideas.differentiator: Score formula is shown openly and adjustable.
ideas.challenges: API rate limits; metrics are proxies, not truth.
ideas.datasetsNote: GitHub public API; verify current rate limits.
ideas.demoSuggestion: Analyse a repo chosen by a judge.
